== Build notes ==
* Created 12 November 2026 from the 20 two-page 600 dpi TIFF spreads in the public "SWCCG Scans" Google Drive folder "Rulebook (from Premiere Starter Deck)" (Wayback 20261112195026). Each spread was cut at the spine (spread 00 = back cover left, front cover right; spread ''n'' = pages 2''n'' and 2''n''+1). Page images are lossless PNG at full resolution. The PDF uses 600 dpi JPEG (quality 92) per page, 60.4 MB.
* The PNG pages (about 5–7 MB each) and the PDF are over the 2 MB web upload limit, so they were imported server-side with importImages as Comlink Cursor. Server settings were not changed.
* The original TIFFs are not on the wiki. Byte-exact copies with a SHA-256 manifest are kept off-wiki (swccg-guild/work#288).
* Page 39 prints Decipher's role addresses (DJediMaster and DCustServe at decipher.com) in the scan. These are Decipher contact addresses, not personal ones, and are left in the image.

== Missing data ==
* The month of publication isn't printed in the booklet. [[Rulebooks]] lists December 1995 (with the Premiere Limited release); the booklet itself prints only © 1995.
